findings.change: Checked by search: goldenmoontea.com also gives the New York account. Text unchanged; added that page to sources.

findings.problem: Stated that lemon and milk together curdle. The Library makes it conditional on enough acid.
The answer "Maltier, not dependably stronger" was the longest and the only hedged option, and two wrong options (green tea, bergamot) would fool no trained person.
findings.change: The three wrong options are now "Stronger by law, with more caffeine", "Lighter, built on Darjeeling" and "Brisker, built only on Kenyan CTC". The answer and explain are unchanged.
